extension.summary: Personalised movie and TV show lists for Kodi.
extension.description: Create and maintain personalised movie and TV show lists from natural-language requests. Use Keyword Matching without AI, connect an optional AI service for nuanced recommendations, browse locally in Kodi, and optionally sync lists to Trakt. Dynamic Lists can merge existing lists and add-on paths without AI.
extension.disclaimer: curatr sends prompts and likes / dislikes information to the services you enable. API keys and Trakt tokens are stored locally by Kodi and are never included in curatr backups.
extension.news: curatr 1.0.42 applies keyword filters and personal exclusions before filling result budgets, checks complete creator credits and keeps history constraints alongside other filters. Explicit writer/director roles, runtime, country, release windows and sorting are enforced. Empty results explain all-versus-any genres, missing references and exclusions. Service failures retain the draft. Connector spacing is balanced; existing finishes and layouts are retained.
